Name: JA and FS - Trafalgar Law Hats
Author: myAphelion
Description:
Just a simple mod that adds a couple hats to the Hat Mouse's shop. Both are 1000G. The pre-timeskip hat is based on the Bowler Hat while the post-timeskip hat is based on the Trucker Hat.

Inspired lovingly by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9796]Straw Hat - Luffy Style[/url]﻿ mod and my own deep affection for Law.

EDIT 03/18/23 - Fashion Sense version added!
